map.8.8 级的屈服强度为什么取 640MPa？: Why Is the Yield Strength of Grade 8.8 Taken as 640 MPa?
map.8.8 级螺栓的公称屈服强度为 640MPa（即 8×8×10），抗拉强度 80: A grade 8.8 bolt has a nominal yield strength of 640 MPa (that is 8×8×10) and a tensile strength of 800 MPa. This tool uses the grade value you enter directly as the yield stress, so enter 640 for grade 8.8 and 900 for grade 10.9. Consult GB/T 3098.1 to confirm the guaranteed stress and yield strength of a specific designation.
map.为什么没考虑预紧力和疲劳？: Why Are Pretension and Fatigue Not Considered?
map.本工具是简化静强度校核，只算外载荷产生的平均应力。实际受拉螺栓连接中预紧力会显著: This tool is a simplified static strength check that only counts the average stress from external loads. In a real tensioned bolt connection the pretension markedly changes how load is shared between bolt and connected parts, alternating loads need a fatigue check, and important connections should be calculated in detail per standards such as VDI 2230.
